vacancies.instEn: Central Provincial Public Service Commission
vacancies.descEn: Open competitive examination for recruitment to Grade III of the Central Provincial Management Service Officers Service, with 242 vacancies. The post is permanent and pensionable with salary scale MN 02-2025.

Educational qualifications: GCE (O/L) in six subjects at one sitting with credit passes in four subjects including Language (Sinhala/Tamil/English) and Mathematics; and GCE (A/L) passed in all subjects (except Common General Test) at one sitting (or three subjects under old syllabus) or equivalent. vacancies.titleEn: Deputy Commissioner of Welfare Benefits (Finance Management)
vacancies.instEn: Welfare Benefits Board, Ministry of Finance, Planning and Economic Development
vacancies.descEn: The role involves managing monthly welfare benefit payments to nearly two million beneficiaries, preparing payment reports, handling bank account transfers, investigating fraudulent claims, coordinating with district and divisional secretariats, presenting annual financial statistics, and conducting procurement activities.
vacancies.age: 22-45 yrs (upper age limit not applicable to internal candidates)
vacancies.salary: 96,650 - 10 x 2,480 - 15 x 3,450 – 173,200 (MM 1-3); Basic Salary Step: Rs.85,896 (As per Schedule 11 of DMS Circular No. 01/2026) plus approved government allowances and communication facilities
vacancies.qualEn: External Candidates: 1) A Degree in Accountancy, Finance Management, Commerce, Business Studies, or any other degree relevant to the subject area recognized by the University Grants Commission AND a minimum of four years post-qualifying experience in the relevant field after obtaining the first degree. OR 2) Having passed the Intermediate Examination of a recognized professional Chartered Institute with relevant subject area and a minimum four years post-qualifying experience. Internal Candidates: 1) Having obtained the qualifications required by external candidates above. OR 2) Completion of minimum three years satisfactory service in a post in the MM1-1 Category in the subject area relevant to the post.

vacancies.instEn: Cey-Nor Foundation Limited
vacancies.descEn: The General Manager will oversee the operations of Cey-Nor Foundation Limited, a fully government-owned company under the Ministry of Fisheries that manufactures fishing vessels and leisure boats for the fisheries industry and sells fishing equipment. The role requires senior managerial leadership with extensive experience in boat manufacturing, design, and business promotion.
vacancies.salary: HM 1-3 – 2025: Rs. 152,500/- + 15 × Rs. 4,100/- = Rs. 214,000/- (2026 salary: Rs. 133,028/- per Management Services Circular No. 01/2025); Allowances: Cost of Living Allowance Rs. 17,800/-, Professional Allowance Rs. 25,000/-, Fuel Allowance 145 liters, Vehicle Allowance Rs. 50,000/-, Telephone Allowance Rs. 4,250/-
vacancies.qualEn: External Applicants: A First Degree in Engineering / Science / Management / Law / Business Administration / Public Administration or Finance from a UGC-recognized university, together with a Master's Degree or Associate Membership of a recognized professional institution, and knowledge and experience in boat manufacturing, boat designing and business promotion. AND a minimum of 15 years' experience at managerial level in a Government Corporation, Statutory Board or recognized private sector organization after obtaining the degree, of which at least 3 years after postgraduate qualification. Internal Applicants: Minimum 3 years satisfactory service as Assistant General Manager in the Senior Management Service Category of Cey-Nor Foundation Limited.

vacancies.instEn: Eastern University, Sri Lanka
vacancies.descEn: Part-time Director role to strengthen Knowledge and Technology Transfer Offices (KTTO) at Eastern University. Responsibilities include developing industry-oriented student projects, organizing trainings and consulting services, implementing IP policy, promoting university spin-offs and research cooperation, building strategic alliances, coordinating KTTO initiatives, and facilitating innovation-driven economic impact and technology transfer between university and industry.
vacancies.qualEn: A Senior Academic staff (Senior Lecturer Gr.II or above position) and adequate experiences in the relevant field also be considered for the appointment. Required professional competencies: developing practice and business oriented student projects; organizing trainings and coaching activities for business; implementing (technical) consulting services for business; implementing an IP policy at universities; promoting the creation of University Spin-offs; promoting research cooperation between businesses and the University; promoting strategic alliances with the private sector; design, coordination and monitoring of KTTO initiatives and projects; building strong key partnerships for development and funding; facilitating innovation-driven economic impact; facilitating knowledge and technology transfer between universities and industry including research commercialization, intellectual property management, industry collaboration.
howToApply: Submit application with a copy of CV through proper channel to the Vice-Chancellor
Apply on or before 15.10.2026
requiredDocuments: CV

vacancies.instEn: University of the Visual and Performing Arts
vacancies.descEn: The Vice-Chancellor serves as the Principal Executive, Academic, and Accounting Officer of the university, responsible for executing Council policies, directing academic affairs, introducing management policies, and upholding academic excellence, transparency, accountability, and democratic leadership. The role requires a record of high academic achievements, strong research profile, proven leadership, interpersonal skills, policy understanding, and commitment to the university's mission.
vacancies.qualEn: Citizen of Sri Lanka; less than 63 years of age by closing date; record of high academic achievements including a strong research profile; proven leadership qualities and interpersonal skills to interact objectively with diverse interest groups; clear understanding of policy issues and commitment to effective implementation; deep understanding of the ethos and mission of a university including its commitment to the community.
vacancies.selectionMethod: Presentation before Special Council meeting (10-15 minutes) and evaluation based on criteria: Strategic Focus, Effective Leadership, Holistic Thinking/Conceptual Skills, Academic and Research Excellence, Personal Integrity, Professional Communication, Managerial Competence as per UGC Circular No. 03/2023.
howToApply: Prepare application with: (i) statement of Vision for university development, (ii) brief account of proposals if appointed, (iii) Curriculum Vitae including date of birth and copy of NIC/passport.
If incumbent or former Vice-Chancellor, include report highlighting accomplishments during first term.
If serving in Public Service, Corporations, Statutory Bodies or Higher Educational Institutions, include employer letter indicating releasability.
Send soft copy of all documents plus cover letter in PDF to registrar@vpa.ac.lk by deadline.

Send hard copy addressed to Registrar/Secretary to the Council, University of the Visual and Performing Arts, 21, Albert Crescent, Colombo 07, under registered cover or hand delivered to reach by 3.00 p.m. on 20.10.2026.
Mark envelope top left corner with 'Post of Vice-Chancellor'.
requiredDocuments: Statement of Vision for the development of the University
Brief account of what applicant proposes to achieve if appointed
Curriculum Vitae including date of birth
Copy of National Identity Card or valid passport
Report highlighting accomplishments during first period of office (if incumbent/former VC)
Letter from employer indicating whether applicant could be released (if serving in Public Service, Corporations, Statutory Bodies or Higher Educational Institutions)
Cover letter
Any other supporting documents

vacancies.instEn: Janatha Estates Development Board
vacancies.descEn: The Manager - Human Resources and Administration is responsible for all institutional activities, financial and administrative functions, human resource development planning, management, and supervision in accordance with government circulars and institutional policies. Selected candidates must perform duties as assigned.
vacancies.qualEn: External: University Grants Commission recognized degree in Human Resource Management or Management, and minimum 1 year experience in relevant field after degree. Internal: Either same qualifications as external, or serving as 'Executive Officer' in JM salary scale with minimum 5 years satisfactory service in relevant field.
howToApply: Send application by registered post to Chairman, People's Bank Development Board, 55/75 Yawaksha Place, Colombo 02
Application must be received on or before 2026-10-19
Mark the post applied for on the top left corner of the envelope
Include names of referees in the application
